newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks plummet 3.35 pct at close on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks plummet 3.35 pct at close on rumours.

text.p: Thai stocks closed sharply down on Wednesday after rumours that a major finance firm was struggling to meet payments on its promissory notes, broker said.
Worries that key central bank data due on Thursday might fail to show any further improvemnet in Thailand's already slow economy also weighed on sentiment, they added.
The SET Index lost 28.24 points, or 3.35 percent to close at 814.39. The SET 50 fell 2.62 points, or 4.14 percent, to 60.73. Turnover was 4.08 billion baht.
